summary: All raw-mass-two measures dominated by a fixed bounded MA have canonical maximizing L1 limits and J=0; specified2delta_x now has dual bounds3/8 to4, but no equation.
detailedSummary: For mu<=A MA(w), D(mu)<=A(1+Bw)+(3/2)A^2 Bw. Every fast family obeys int|aj-u|mu<=(16A/15)2^-4j eventually, with actual integrability, bounded-truncation convergence and uniform integrability. New explicit half-mixture dominates2delta_x with A=2,Bw=1/4. No C/G recognition of its Borel limit, no K=0, no nu=mu or whole-mass Dirac existence inferred.
text:
Using earlier own n1 and n2, domination by a fixed actual bounded MA measure eliminates the prescribed-measure integral defect, WITHOUT asserting analytic recognition. Let mu be ANY positive raw-mass2 Radon measure with mu<=A MA(w), w in original C bounded and A finite. Equal masses give A>=1. Write Bw=D(MA(w))=E(w)-int w MA(w), finite by bounded tangent concavity. Then D(mu)<=A(1+Bw)+(3/2)A^2 Bw<infinity, so these arbitrary-support inputs are eligible for the ORIGINAL FULL dual.

Proof of the bound. Normalize a by sup0 and put C=-E(a), A0=int(-a)theta^2<=1, q0=Q_theta(a), q1=Q_theta_a(a). Cubic differentiation gives C=A0+2q0/3+q1/3 and -E(ta)=tA0+t^2(1-t/3)q0+t^3 q1/3<=t+(3/2)t^2 C. Apply the full dual Bw to ta and divide by t. Optimizing t=min(1,sqrt(2Bw/(3C))), with the zero cases treated by limits, gives int(-a)MA(w)<=1+Bw+sqrt(6Bw C). Domination yields Fmu(a)<=-C+A(1+Bw)+A sqrt(6Bw C). Maximizing the scalar quadratic in sqrt C proves the claimed bound. This proof does not need skeletal support, absolute continuity of mu against a geometric volume form or a smooth positivity margin.

Every normalized full-dual maximizing family is Cauchy in L1(mu), with a family-independent limit. Coercivity puts late terms in a common C-energy sublevel. Midpoint gives I(ai,aj)<=4(epsilon_i+epsilon_j), and the fixed-w absolute modulus in n1, multiplied by A, tends to0. Completeness of L1(mu) supplies a limit; comparison of two families on their product indices proves independence, without assuming countable cofinality of nets. In particular every maximizing sequence has uniform integrability of its negative functions, after handling its finitely many initial terms.

More precisely, for EVERY fast sequence with the n1 diagonal estimates, select k so normalized w lies in C_(C+k). For j>=k, int h_j MA(w)<=sum_(n>=j)2^-4n, h_j=sum_(n>=j)|a_(n+1)-an|, by countable Tonelli. Its exceptional set N is MA(w)-null and therefore mu-null. Outside N the actual pointwise limit u satisfies |aj-u|<=h_j. Consequently, for every sufficiently late j,
int|aj-u|mu <= A sum_(n>=j)2^-4n = (16A/15)2^-4j.
This proves actual mu-integrability and L1 convergence to the actual Borel u, not just signed integral convergence. Its integral is e-D(mu), so J=int u mu-(e-Dmu)=0. The bounded truncations converge in L1 and the negative functions are uniformly integrable: for vn=-an,v=-u, (vn-T)+ <=|vn-v|+(v-T)+; first control a late tail, then finitely many initial integrable functions. Thus both requirements in the earlier exact loss split are supplied. No positivity/energy/MA is assigned to u, no statement u in C/G is inferred, and K or nu=mu need not follow from this argument.

For the specified x=x_(1/8), n2 gives an EXPLICIT actual bounded q with MA(q)=delta_g+delta_x and full dual1/4. Hence2delta_x<=2MA(q), taking A=2. The ORIGINAL whole-mass nonskeletal Dirac now satisfies J=0 for every fast family, int|aj-u|2delta_x <=(32/15)2^-4j eventually, and all normalized maximizing families have the same L1(2delta_x) limit. Evaluating q at the target, E(q)=-3/8 and q(x)=-3/8, gives D(2delta_x)>=3/8. The domination bound gives D(2delta_x)<=2(1+1/4)+(3/2)*4*(1/4)=4. These are rigorous bounds, not an exact dual computation. The old tiny projection-gap bound is strengthened substantially. We have not proved K=0, actual G membership of its canonical relaxation, attainment or MA of an actual solution equal to2delta_x. Its equation and nonordered analytic representation remain OPEN.

The complete proof is in new-residual-proofs.tex and standalone.tex, with exact reading/application ledgers and byte-unchanged original-residual.txt. Rerun: python assemble_delivery.py > assemble-delivery.log; python check_delivery.py > check-delivery.log. This is a complete dominated-measure convergence theorem and a narrower explicit equation sector from n2, not unchanged P16.7 closure.
